title: Self-Audit Module for Public Summarizers (v3) — PER, DSL, Query Fidelity, Erasure Skew, α_T, Π_d, Β under the Atomic Token Rule
creator: Lee Sharks · Nobel Glas · Damascus Dancings
description:
A v3.0 standing metric module by Lee Sharks, Nobel Glas, and Damascus Dancings for auditing individual public-summarizer outputs. It hardens the earlier module against **token-bag audit**, in which a referentially closed name or concept is decomposed into lexical parts and scored as though token retention were entity fidelity.

The protocol makes the Atomic Token Rule a precondition and integrates Query Fidelity, PER, Directionality of Semantic Labor, visible Erasure Skew, Atomic Token Preservation, Referential Dispersal, Audit-Performance Bifurcation, Legibility Threshold, and a composite Summarizer Audit Score. It requires inspection of the query, cited sources, and named referent and states that self-audit is not self-certifying: verification must leave the producing system. The module audits one output at one time and expressly does not measure systemic mediation dynamics.
